about: Benefit values where the 2027 plan brochure (the plan's official statement of benefits) disagrees with OPM's benefits spreadsheet and the brochure was checked by hand. pipeline/build_data.py applies each entry to data/benefits.json: the engine field (deductible, oop_max, out_of_network.deductible or an rx tier) gets the brochure value, the listed raw fields show the brochure text, and benefits[code].overrides keeps the spreadsheet value, page, quote and reason (the app shows a 'Differs from OPM spreadsheet' badge). An out_of_network.deductible entry has no raw fields (the spreadsheet's out-of-network row has none); its record is kept under 'Out-of-network annual deductible'. Each entry's 'sheet' must equal the spreadsheet value or the build stops.

overrides.quote: The calendar year deductible for the Basic Option is $4,800 per person.

also.quote: $4,800 deductible
The calendar year deductible for Basic Option is: $4,800 per person ($9,600 per Self Plus One enrollment, or $9,600 per Self and Family enrollment).

overrides.reason: Every mention in the Sharp Health Plan brochure (Section 4 page 24, the Basic Option overview page 29, Section 5 pages 31, 48 and 56; page numbers are the PDF pages of the brochure text file) gives $4,800 per person / $9,600 for Self Plus One and Self and Family; $5,500 appears nowhere in it. The out-of-pocket maximums ($8,100 / $16,200) agree with the spreadsheet. The brochure is the plan's official statement of benefits.
